THE PROBLEM

A forwarded voice note can't take it back.

Schools send notices into parent group chats. When a time changes, the correction travels slower than the original, and an audio file that is already on someone's phone can never be updated.

A RECORDED VOICE NOTE

Record it again and send it again.
The old recording keeps getting forwarded.
Nobody can tell which version is current.
In May 2026, Lagos State's Office of Education Quality Assurance publicly told schools to disregard a circulating message claiming students would be dismissed early the next day.
Source: OEQA Lagos, “Urgent Notice: Disregard Circulating Message on School Dismissal”. A real example of why corrections matter. It does not show that audio would have prevented it, and AfterSend is not affiliated with OEQA.

HOW IT WORKS

Write, listen, share.

The voice keeps up with your words, so there is no Generate button to remember.

Step 1
Write it

Type or paste the announcement. Dates, times and phone numbers are picked out so you can check each one.

Step 2
Hear it

The spoken version is prepared automatically when you stop typing, and refreshed whenever you edit. Nothing goes public yet.

Step 3
Share one link

Listen to the whole preview, publish, and share the link wherever parents already are. That link stays the same.

WHEN A NOTICE CHANGES

Fix the words. The link keeps working.

Edit the announcement and the new spoken version is prepared for you. Until you approve it, the link keeps playing the previous version. The moment you do, everyone who already has the link hears the correction, with the full text beside it.

Each version keeps its own text and audio, so the page never pairs old audio with new words.

REAL SPEECH

Natural spoken announcements, prepared as you type.

Speech is generated by AssemblyAI's text-to-speech. You pick a voice, stop typing, and the preview refreshes by itself. You hear the real result before anything is published, and again for every correction.

Choose a voice

Pick from the voices the speech service offers. They are synthetic narrators, never a real person's voice.

Edit freely

Each pause in typing refreshes the preview. A newer edit always replaces an older preview.

Listen, then approve

TRUST AND LIMITS

What AfterSend will not do.

A correction tool is only useful if you can trust its limits.

Recall files

Downloaded or forwarded audio stays as it is. Only the link updates.

Verify publishers

AfterSend does not check who a publisher is. There are no verified badges.

Check facts

Speech reads the approved text. Making sure it is correct is the publisher's job.

Publish on its own

Every first announcement and every correction needs a person to approve it.

Clone voices

Only stock synthetic narrator voices. Never a real person's voice.

Send messages

AfterSend gives you a link. You decide where to share it.
